diagnosis: accept_workspace_invitation validates the invite key and automatically provisions membership for request.user into the inviting organization. Because the code fails to verify that request.user.email matches invitation.email, an attacker who intercepts or obtains an invite link intended for an executive can redeem it using their own account to infiltrate the victim workspace.
